atoms.a: We’re going on holiday to Spain this week, and I’m so excited. We’ve never been to Spain before, only Portugal, so it’s really exciting. I’ve already been packing all my outfits, and my parents have been planning what we’re going to do while we’re there. We’ll definitely try some Spanish tapas because they’re meant to be really tasty. We aren’t sure what the weather will be like though. The weather forecast isn’t looking that good - it’ll be hot some days but raining on the others. Either way, it’s going to be the best holiday ever!
